description: tests/unit/sql_compat/test_sqlglot_overlay_guard.py::test_repo_has_no_vacuous_sqlglot_overlays and tests/unit/sql_compat/test_vendored_sqlglot_bypass.py::test_upstream_sqlglot_imports_are_exactly_the_allowlisted_project_tools walk the filesystem, so a git-ignored `_project/scripts/.venv` (created by any `uv run --project _project/scripts`, including the batch-* targets and the todo-db tracker CLI) puts PyPI sqlglot files into their scan and both fail. Restrict both scans to tracked files (git ls-files) or skip git-ignored directories.
